  "sessions_a": 900,
  "sessions_b": 900,
  "rate_a": 0.38,
  "rate_b": 0.4667,
  "abs_lift": 0.0867,
  "rel_lift": 0.2281,
  "p_value": 0.0002,
  "ship_b": true,
  "mean_minutes_a": 13.85,
  "mean_minutes_b": 15.54
}

--- tmp/ab.py ---
import csv,json,math,sys
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('telemetry/playtest_ab.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig')))
seen={};conf=0;bad=[]
for r in rows:
    r={k.strip():(v or '').strip() for k,v in r.items()}
    r['variant']=r['variant'].upper()
    sid=r['session_id']
    if sid in seen:
        if seen[sid]!=r: conf+=1
        continue
    seen[sid]=r
print(len(rows),len(seen),'conflicts',conf)
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r['variant'] for r in seen.values()),Counter(r['completed_tutorial'] for r in seen.values()))
print([r for r in seen.values() if r['match_minutes'] in('','NA') ][:5])
g={}
for v in 'AB':
    s=[r for r in seen.values() if r['variant']==v]
    n=len(s);c=sum(int(r['completed_tutorial']) for r in s)
    m=[float(r['match_minutes']) for r in s if r['match_minutes']!='']
    g[v]=(n,c,sum(m)/len(m),len(m))
(na,ca,ma,_),(nb,cb,mb,_)=g['A'],g['B']
pa,pb=ca/na,cb/nb;p=(ca+cb)/(na+nb)
z=(pb-pa)/math.sqrt(p*(1-p)*(1/na+1/nb))
pv=math.erfc(abs(z)/math.sqrt(2))
out=dict(sessions_a=na,sessions_b=nb,rate_a=round(pa,4),rate_b=round(pb,4),abs_lift=round(pb-pa,4),rel_lift=round((pb-pa)/pa,4),p_value=round(pv,4),ship_b=bool(pv<0.05 and pb>pa),mean_minutes_a=round(ma,2),mean_minutes_b=round(mb,2))
print(g,z,pv)
json.dump(out,open('ab_result.json','w'),indent=2)
print(open('ab_result.json').read())
